description_en: Theśikharatemple (DLK0050) is located on the side of the road in the village of Kimugāũ (east of Nārāyaṇa, the district headquarters). The stone memorial pillar (DLK0050-001) is found nearby, re-used as a step to access a terrassed field.The temple was most probably dismantled or had collapsed and was then rebuilt, as the absence of stone blocks indicate.The memorial pillar is half-buried. Such artefacts were erected throughout the Karnali Basin from the 13th to the 17th century. They are installed to honor the memory of deceased persons, mostly warriors (Andolfatto 2019: 105-119).
description_ne: यो शिखर मन्दिर (DLK0050 तल हेर्नुहवस्) किमुगाऊँ सडकखण्ड नजिकै अवस्थित छ र यो खम्बा (DLK0050-001 तल हेर्नुहवस्) चाहिँ मन्दिर नजिकै बारिमा उक्लने र ओर्लने खुट्किलोको रूपमा प्रयोग भैरहेको अवस्थामा भेटिएको हो । यो मन्दिर कुनै समयमा भत्काएर अथवा आफैं भत्केपछि पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको हुनुपर्दर्छ । खम्बा आधा भाग जमिनमा गाडिएको अवस्थामा छ । यस्ता किसिमका कसैको स्मृतिमा ईशाको तेह्रौंदेखि सत्रौं शताब्दीभित्र ठड्याइएका पुरातात्त्विक खम्बाहरू कर्णाली नदी किनार वरिपरि यततत्र भेटिन्छन् । यी खम्बाहरू विशेषतः युद्धमा मारिएका योद्धाहरूको स्मृतिमा गाडिएका हुन्  (Andolfatto 2019: 105-119 हेर्नुहवस्) ।
identified_threats: Erosion, Other, Missing stones at plinths, Road widening, Encroachment
references: REFERENCES Andolfatto, David C. Le Pays aux Cent-Vingt-Cinq-Mille Montagnes. Etude Archéologique du Bassin de la Karnali (Népal) entre le XIIe et le XVIe siècle . Paris: Sorbonne University, 2019.
